dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: I run an antique store — they call me the most reliable antique appraisal expert in Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: My grandfather was a well-renowned historian, so the gift of antique appreciation runs in our family.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: As such, you can definitely trust my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: Be it accessories of the Goddess of Flowers, or relics of the Dendro Archon, or perhaps even that which King Deshret might have left amidst the desert sands, there is not one that can escape my appraising eye.
